edges.reason: owner() reads the _owner state variable.
Constructor sets _owner through the Ownable constructor using _msgSender().
renounceOwnership writes _owner and is guarded by onlyOwner.
Constructor assigns the full _rTotal supply to _rOwned[_msgSender()].
Constructor mints _rTotal derived from MAX and _tTotal.
Constructor marks owner, contract, team and marketing as fee-exempt.
Constructor stores the team address.
Constructor stores the marketing address.
Constructor uses _msgSender() as the initial recipient/owner.
transfer() delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom() delegates execution to _transfer.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer at the end of execution.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to move balances.
_tokenTransfer zeroes and restores _taxFee around the transfer.
_tokenTransfer zeroes and restores _teamFee around the transfer.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam with the team share.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with the reflection fee.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute amounts.
_transferStandard subtracts rAmount from sender and adds to recipient in _rOwned.
_takeTeam adds rTeam to _rOwned[address(this)].
_takeTeam calls _getRate to derive the current rate.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by rFee.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by tFee.
_transfer computes the contractTokenBalance local.
contractTokenBalance is produced by balanceOf(address(this)).
contractTokenBalance is passed as tokenAmount to swapTokensForEth.
_transfer conditionally calls swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and not inSwap.
_transfer reads the residual contract ETH balance into contractETHBalance.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the contract holds ETH.
_transfer enforces cooldown[to] < block.timestamp then writes cooldown[to].
block.timestamp gates buyer cooldowns, a timestamp-dependent restriction.
msg.sender must equal the router or pair during cooldown-enabled transfers.
_transfer reads the cooldownEnabled flag.
_transfer reads the swapEnabled flag before swapping.
_transfer reads the inSwap guard flag.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount.
_transfer checks the bots blacklist for sender and recipient.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide takeFee.
swapTokensForEth is wrapped by the lockTheSwap modifier.
lockTheSwap sets and clears the inSwap reentrancy guard flag.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call while inSwap is set.
swapTokensForEth calls functions on the uniswapV2Router instance.
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline.
sendETHToFee performs external ETH transfers to team and marketing addresses.
sendETHToFee reads _teamAddress for the first half of the ETH.
sendETHToFee reads _marketingFunds for the second half of the ETH.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract balance.
manualswap requires msg.sender to be the privileged _teamAddress.
manualswap compares the caller against _teamAddress.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
manualsend requires msg.sender to be the privileged _teamAddress.
startTrading performs an external payable addLiquidityETH call.
startTrading performs an external factory.createPair call.
startTrading performs an external approve on the created pair.
startTrading stores the router instance.
startTrading stores the created pair address.
startTrading enables swapping.
startTrading disables cooldownEnabled.
startTrading raises _maxTxAmount.
startTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
block.timestamp is supplied as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
block.timestamp flows into the addLiquidityETH external call deadline.
onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender().
renounceOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setCooldownEnabled is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
startTrading is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
blockBots is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
unblockBot is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setMaxTxPercent is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
setMaxTxPercent writes _maxTxAmount.
setMaxTxPercent multiplies _tTotal by the percentage.
blockBots writes true into the bots mapping for each address.
unblockBot writes false into the bots mapping.
balanceOf calls tokenFromReflection to convert reflections to tokens.
balanceOf reads _rOwned[account].
tokenFromReflection requires rAmount <= _rTotal.
tokenFromReflection calls _getRate.
_getValues calls _getRate to obtain currentRate.
_getValues reads _taxFee for the fee computation.
_getValues reads _teamFee for the team-fee computation.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal for the rSupply side of the rate.
_getCurrentSupply reads _tTotal for the tSupply side of the rate.
_getRate stores the quotient into the currentRate local.
approve ends up writing the _allowances mapping through _approve.
transferFrom reads and subtracts from _allowances.
the amount parameter flows from transfer() into _transfer.
the recipient parameter flows from transfer() into _transfer.
the amount parameter flows from transferFrom() into _transfer and _approve.
maxTxPercent parameter is consumed by the _maxTxAmount computation.
notbot parameter indexes the bots mapping write.
amount parameter is split and transferred in sendETHToFee.
bots_ array elements are iterated and written to the bots mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is a transient transfer() input; it folds into the transfer function node.
amount is a transient transfer() input; it folds into the transfer function node.
maxTxPercent only parameterizes the _maxTxAmount update inside setMaxTxPercent.
notbot only parameterizes the bots mapping write inside unblockBot.
amount is a transient input of sendETHToFee; it folds into that function node.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary derived inside _transfer before the swap call.
contractETHBalance is a temporary derived inside _transfer before sendETHToFee.
bots_ only parameterizes the blacklist loop inside blockBots.
amount is a transient transferFrom() input; it folds into the transferFrom node.
currentRate is a temporary quotient local to _getRate.
